_readme: Drizzle models that omit a tenant column their physical table declares.
Gate: scripts/ci/check-tenant-blind-models.mjs. The list may only SHRINK.
READ BEFORE 'FIXING' ANY cmc-schema ENTRY BELOW. Adding organizationId to
these models WITHOUT first adding an organization predicate to the routes
that use them would CREATE a cross-tenant write that does not exist today.
See the per-entry reason; the divergence is currently masking the missing
authorization check, and removing the mask without adding the check is the

shared/cmc-schema.ts::drugProducts.reason: shared/cmc-schema.ts is a stale parallel definition that does not match the database on ANY of three counts: it models `id` as uuid where the table is serial, and it omits `organization_id` which the table declares NOT NULL. Measured empirically against the real DDL: the INSERT this model produces fails with 'null value in column organization_id violates not-null constraint', and a lookup by uuid fails with 'invalid input syntax for type integer'. The routes in server/api/cmc/projectRoutes.ts that use it therefore 500 rather than leak — the divergence fails closed. The canonical, DDL-matching, tenant-aware definition is shared/schema.ts::drugProducts. FIX ORDER MATTERS: projectRoutes does `db.update(drugProducts).set({...req.body}).where(eq(id, productId))` with NO organization predicate and unvalidated mass assignment. Aligning the model first would turn a dead endpoint into a live cross-tenant write (RLS would still backstop it, but that is one control deep). Point the routes at shared/schema.ts AND add an explicit organization filter in the same change.

shared/cmc-schema.ts::drugSubstances.reason: Same stale cmc-schema.ts definition and same failure mode as drugProducts — uuid vs serial id, no organization_id against a NOT NULL column, so server/api/cmc/projectRoutes.ts inserts fail closed rather than writing untenanted rows. Canonical definition: shared/schema.ts::drugSubstances. Same fix order applies: add the organization predicate to the routes in the same change that aligns the model.

shared/cmc-schema.ts::analyticalMethods.reason: Same stale cmc-schema.ts definition. Canonical definition: shared/schema.ts::analyticalMethods. Baselined rather than fixed because aligning the model without adding an organization predicate to the consuming routes would remove a mask that is currently the only reason the missing check is not exploitable.

shared/cmc-schema.ts::stabilityStudies.reason: Same stale cmc-schema.ts definition. Canonical definition: shared/schema.ts::stabilityStudies. Baselined on the same terms as analyticalMethods.

shared/cmc-schema.ts::complianceTracking.reason: Same stale cmc-schema.ts definition. Canonical definition: shared/schema.ts::complianceTracking. Baselined on the same terms as analyticalMethods.
